# ERP.net Developer Docs

> Guides and API references for building ERP.net apps and integrations.

Choose the authentication flow for the identity your API calls need. Use the target instance's OData metadata for exact entity names and operation signatures.

## Getting started

- [Docs for agents](https://docs.erp.net/dev/agents/index.md): How to find and read the Developer Docs.
- [Building Apps](https://docs.erp.net/dev/building-apps/overview.md): App types, setup, and integration architecture.
- [Site discovery](https://docs.erp.net/dev/building-apps/concepts/application-server-endpoints.md): Find the sites and API endpoints available on an instance.

## Authentication

- [Authentication overview](https://docs.erp.net/dev/auth/overview.md): OAuth flows, Trusted Applications, and scopes.
- [Identity discovery](https://docs.erp.net/dev/auth/concepts/identity-server.md#1-discovery-endpoint): Find the instance's `token_endpoint` URL.
- [Client Credentials setup](https://docs.erp.net/dev/auth/flows/client-credentials/service-apps-step-by-step.md#prerequisites): Configure the Trusted Application and its System User for a background integration.
- [Client Credentials token request](https://docs.erp.net/dev/auth/flows/client-credentials/service-apps-token.md): Request an access token using `grant_type=client_credentials` and use it in an API call.
- [Token Exchange](https://docs.erp.net/dev/auth/flows/token-exchange.md): Exchange a subject token for an API access token.
- [Supported Token Exchange use cases](https://docs.erp.net/dev/auth/flows/token-exchange-use-cases.md): Agent impersonation and its supported JWT claims.
- [Agent token exchange sample](https://docs.erp.net/dev/auth/samples/token-exchange-agent-example.md): A complete HTTP token request, response, and Domain API call.
- [Authorization Code walkthrough](https://docs.erp.net/dev/auth/flows/auth-code/interactive-apps-step-by-step.md): Sign in interactively and redeem an authorization code for tokens.
- [API scopes](https://docs.erp.net/dev/auth/concepts/scopes.md): Choose the permissions to request when obtaining an access token.

## Domain API

- [Domain API](https://docs.erp.net/dev/domain-api/index.md): OData access to ERP.net business objects.
- [OData request URLs](https://docs.erp.net/dev/domain-api/querying-data/url-components.md): Combine the discovered service root, resource path, and query string.
- [Supported OData query options](https://docs.erp.net/dev/domain-api/querying-data/query-options/index.md): Use the options and ERP.net extensions supported by the Domain API.
- [Domain API filters](https://docs.erp.net/dev/domain-api/querying-data/query-options/filter.md): Combine conditions with `and`, use `in` for supported field values, and look up ERP.net functions such as `equalnull` and `like`. General `or` expressions are unsupported.
- [Custom properties](https://docs.erp.net/dev/domain-api/common-tasks/stored-attributes.md): Discover instance-specific fields and read, set, clear, or filter their values.
- [Calculated attributes](https://docs.erp.net/dev/domain-api/common-tasks/calculated-attributes.md): Discover calculated fields and request their values with `$select`.
- [Domain API transactions](https://docs.erp.net/dev/domain-api/data-manipulation/transactions.md): Use `TransactionId` to group requests and explicitly commit or roll back.
- [Paging results](https://docs.erp.net/dev/domain-api/querying-data/paging.md): Set `$top` and follow the returned `@odata.nextLink` for multi-page reads.
- [Operations and instance metadata](https://docs.erp.net/dev/domain-api/operations/index.md): Confirm action and function signatures in `$metadata` and choose the correct HTTP method.
- [Domain Model](https://docs.erp.net/model/entities/): Standard entities, fields, and relationships.

## Other APIs and extensions

- [Table API](https://docs.erp.net/dev/table-api/index.md): Table data access for reporting and integrations.
- [Scripting](https://docs.erp.net/dev/scripting/index.md): ERP.net scripts and examples.
- [Developing for WebClient](https://docs.erp.net/dev/web-client/index.md): Extend the ERP.net web client.
- [Developing for the Marketplace](https://docs.erp.net/dev/marketplace/index.md): Build apps for the ERP.net Marketplace.
